svg.title: D - Single-unit value against the joint value of the pool
svg.desc: Protocol s. 5's value of information is complementary, not additive, on these networks: verifying one cable at a time is worth between about 13 and 280 times less than verifying the pool (sum / joint = 0.074, 0.0036 and 0.0047 for semiurb4, semiurb5 and urban6), because the series segments co-block. The filled marker sums the pool units' single-unit VoI_E.expected_MWh over n = 100 prior samples; the hollow marker is the joint value, export(B4) - export(B2) on E over n = 200 truth draws. The two have different draw sets by construction, which is why they are shown as a pair and not as a difference, and the ratio of the two is printed per network. The y axis is logarithmic in MWh. No uncertainty is drawn. Source: results/eval_<network>_U2.json, fields voi[].VoI_E.expected_MWh, policies.B4.na.export_MWh.mean and policies.B2.na.export_MWh.mean. Contains information from SimBench (simbench.de), made available under the Open Database License (ODbL 1.0). See analysis/asset_rating_information/DATA_ATTRIBUTION.md.
